event_summary: A black kettlebell descends onto a white cup on a wooden tabletop and the cup visibly flattens beneath it.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a white cup lying on its side on a wooden tabletop while a black kettlebell is partly visible above it. The kettlebell moves downward toward the cup. Its lower rounded part contacts the upper side of the cup, after which the cup changes from a rounded cup shape to a flattened, folded shape under the kettlebell. The kettlebell remains upright over the deformed cup near the end of the video.

reasons: The white cup and tabletop are clearly visible before contact.
Only the lower edge of the black object is visible near the top of the frame.
